name: "Maha Vasudevayaputra"
desc: Said to be a descendant of an ancient deity widely worshipped in Sumeru, the World-Bestowing Lord, this being exudes an aroma uniquely rich and savory, one unmistakably belonging to fungi. The belief that plump shrooms are gifts from the gods, even manifestations of sacred flesh, has had a long and venerable history in Sumeru. However, the fact that the Dendro Archon bears no evident connection to fungi at all has been a contradiction that has troubled Vahumana researchers for years and years. Nevertheless, should they ever be granted a glimpse of this divine scion's true form, maybe they would also finally have the answer to this long-standing puzzle.
